title: Add regression tests for the fail-closed gate and the allow-list defaults
description: Add vitest integration cases to applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server covering: (a) an MCP client that omits the elicitation capability is refused on tools/call for each confirmation-required tool and no operation runs; (b) a client that advertises elicitation must answer a confirmation prompt before the tool executes; (c) with the default configuration tools/list registers no write-capable tool outside the explicit allow-list; (d) the task 1 forced-confirmation flag refuses destructive tools regardless of client capability; (e) a security log line is emitted for every confirmation decision. The unit-tests CI gate is blocking (sdlc/policy.json ciGates), so the cases run on every PR to protected main. Constraints: tests only, no deployment, no change to the task 1 and task 2 behaviour being asserted.
acceptanceCriteria: pnpm vitest run in applications/mcp-gateway/repos/mongodb-mcp-server executes the new cases and all pass against the merged main branch.
Temporarily reverting src/elicitation.ts to the fail-open branch makes case (a) fail, proving the suite detects the fnd_01M2K7B0MJ68AR00YTNE2N00V2 / fnd_01M2KBJW4AHE221KPTRV1G60YC regression.

verificationMethod.description: Run pnpm vitest run in the local checkout and in the PR CI run: expected result - every new confirmation and allow-list case passes; then re-apply the old fail-open branch locally and confirm case (a) turns red, showing the tests guard the fix.

rootCause.description: No test exercised the confirmation gate for clients without elicitation capability or the default tool-registration surface, so the fail-open defect and the over-broad write defaults passed review undetected.
